recipes.description: Inherited PGmc i, j-created iww-to-iuw reanalysis and conditioned long-io realization, using existing diphthong mutation.
recipes.assumptions: Defended Ringe-Taylor working chain at p.250: PGmc hiwja, PWGmc palatalized iww, iuw, pre-OE long iow, WS long iew. CAPR ww+j and w+j serialize the source's palatalized geminate/semivowel conditioning; they do not assert its uncertain phonemic analysis. The distinct j-created reanalysis precedes a specifically conditioned long-io realization; ordinary inherited au/eu/iu consumers remain unchanged.
recipes.limitations: Private candidate, not adopted production or corpus fields. Fulk pp.71-72 disputes conventional j-created geminate dismantling, illustrated by strew/new; this is a substantive alternative, not erased by preserved finals. E-input dictionary conventions and their claimed PGmc stage remain explicit disagreement. SC106 stays composed for domain comparison although the candidate hue no longer feeds it. No general endingless or analogy repair is claimed.
